events.title: Update: a steadier camera, cheaper Medics and Runners
events.summary: A small update for the demo and the full game, straight from Next Fest feedback. Changes The camera stays put when your men go over the top. You can keep shoring up the line instead of being dragged across no man's land. Prefer the old follow-cam? Switch on OTT auto-scroll in Settings. Boot Camp mentions it. events.title: Dirt & Viscera is in Steam Next Fest
events.summary: Steam Next Fest starts today, and the free Sector One demo of Dirt & Viscera: The Great War is part of it until 26 October. If you haven't played it yet: you hold a section of the Western Front with whatever the cards deal you, from riflemen and machine guns to flamethrowers, gas and the odd Mark IV. Then you decide when to stop holding and go over the top. Go too early and the wire takes them. Go too late and the trench is overrun. The demo is the whole of Sector One: a branching map of battles

events.title: Update: machine guns and artillery from day one
events.summary: A new demo build is live, just in time for Next Fest. Everything below is in the full game too. New Machine guns and artillery from the start. Every company now begins with both, so your very first battles have real choices in them instead of an hour of riflemen. Boot Camp covers more. The drill sergeant now explains call-ins, the request buttons, the hold-back slider, sending the next wave and pausing. He has also become slightly ruder. events.title: Update: aim your Strafing Run, plus two new Depot upgrades
events.summary: A new demo build is live. Everything below is in the full game too. New Aim your Strafing Run. Click and drag to set the line the plane flies. A plain click still sends it straight up the field, and you now see the lane before you commit. Armour Leads (Depot, 150 glory). Adds a Send Armour order: your tanks roll out on their own, and the infantry stay in the trench until you send them over behind the armour. Fire Discipline (Depot, 120 glory, needs Mortar Team). events.title: Demo update: menu fixes, tooltips and two new buttons
events.summary: A small update to the Sector One demo is now live.FixesThe main menu now fits on smaller screens, and on PCs with Windows display scaling turned up. Before, the title and some buttons could be cut off.- Tooltips now appear in the game's own style instead of the plain Windows box.NewTwo buttons sit next to your cards in battle. Request reinforcements: each click shaves a little off the wait for your next cards. Request requisition: each click scrapes together a little more requisition. Click away
